title: The Impact of Personalized AI Response Suggestions on Content Creators' Direct Messaging
abstract: arXiv:2610.34770v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Direct messaging is often employed by social media content creators to directly interact with followers. Those creators attempt to engage with followers in private communication, but they often encounter a large volume of messages. Through formative interviews with 15 creators, we found that creators frequently experience fatigue from writing suitable content, as they moderate audience expectations while concurrently integrating their media personas into responses. To explore how AI can address these challenges, we designed a system providing personalized, AI-generated response suggestions tailored to creators' writing styles to maintain their media personas. In a comparison study with 13 creators that examines how the system affects response behaviors, creators valued the system's ability to soften potential impoliteness and anticipated higher response rates, helping them maintain a professional image. translated_title: 个性化AI回复建议对内容创作者私信的影响
translated_abstract: 私信是社交媒体内容创作者与粉丝直接互动的常用方式。这些创作者试图通过私人交流与粉丝建立联系，但他们往往面临大量消息的涌入。通过对15位创作者的形成性访谈，我们发现创作者经常因撰写合适的内容而感到疲惫，因为他们既要管理粉丝的期望，又要将自己的媒体人设融入回复之中。为了探索AI如何应对这些挑战，我们设计了一个系统，提供根据创作者写作风格量身定制的个性化AI生成回复建议，以帮助维持他们的媒体人设。在一项有13位创作者参与的对比研究中，我们考察了该系统如何影响回复行为。创作者重视该系统缓和潜在不礼貌表达的能力，并预期这将带来更高的回复率，帮助他们维持专业形象。然而，创作者也报告了额外的……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究设计了一个根据创作者写作风格定制的个性化AI回复建议系统，帮助内容创作者在私信中维持媒体人设、缓和语气并提升回复效率与专业形象，但创作者也表达了一些顾虑。
